name: Soft Materials: Colloids, Gels, Liquid Crystals & Foams
summary: Studies soft matter, whose behaviour is dominated by weak interactions and thermal fluctuations, from colloids and gels to liquid crystals and self-assembly.

topics.name: Intermolecular and surface forces: van der Waals, electrostatic double layer and DLVO theory
Colloidal dispersions: stability, aggregation and Brownian motion
Polymer and colloidal gels; hydrogels and swelling
Liquid crystals: nematic, smectic and cholesteric phases; order parameter and displays
Rheology of complex fluids: yield stress, shear thickening and thixotropy
